name: layout18
description: Adaptive Korean iMessage / iOS photo-dump editorial collage with a chaotic-fun digital-native aesthetic. Before composing this layout, analyze the first uploaded image and extract three things: (1) dominant color palette — identify the 2–3 hero colors and 1–2 accent tones present in the outfit; (2) outfit aesthetic/mood — classify the overall vibe (e.g. Y2K baddie, soft feminine, preppy, dark academic, streetwear, etc.); (3) outfit motif or texture — identify any recurring pattern or material quality (graphic text print, solid jersey, lace, gingham, leather, floral, etc.). Color rule: all UI chrome, chat bubble colors, decorative cutout tones, and overlay accents must use a complementary or contrasting palette relative to the outfit's dominant color — not the same hue (e.g. white outfit → cobalt blue or deep violet UI accents; pink outfit → teal or olive; black outfit → warm gold or electric lime). Complementary contrast should feel bold and digital-fun — punchy but not discordant. Background is a cool-toned or neutral solid in a complementary tone to the outfit (slightly darkened or muted), overlaid with large semi-transparent circle/bubble shapes at low opacity. Layout structure fully mimics an iOS app screen in use: iOS status bar at top (No SIM / WiFi / time / battery) in a neutral complementary tone; simulated iOS app header (e.g. 'Albums' or social app title) in system font; main photo area in upper two-thirds: one large full-bleed hero portrait as background anchor, one small borderless portrait card upper-left (slightly tilted), one medium borderless portrait upper-right (straight, overlapping the hero); lower third: simulated iMessage or DM chat bubble exchange — two or three bubbles with short playful bilingual text (Indonesian + emoji or English + emoji), rendered as realistic iOS message bubbles with send-bubble color drawn from the complementary palette (not the outfit color); below chat bubbles, simulated iOS photo-picker or attachment tray showing 2–3 small thumbnail portraits in a horizontal strip with iOS-style close (×) buttons and comment/send input bar. Decorative graphic elements: derive element types from the aesthetic mood of the first uploaded image (e.g. Y2K/baddie → scattered fresh fruit cutout, paper airplane cutout, vintage pocket watch or clock cutout, lush green plant stem cutout; soft feminine → flower and ribbon cutouts, bubble overlays; streetwear → spray-paint marks, bold sticker graphics, chain hardware cutout; dark academic → ink stamp, dried botanical, book page scrap) — but render all element colors in the complementary/contrasting palette, not the outfit's own colors. Transparent bubble/circle overlays in complementary light tone at 15–30% opacity. All cutout and accent colors must stay within the complementary color story. Clean high-contrast styling, indoor or mixed lighting photography. Follow the iOS screen UI structure with chat bubble lower section; adapt slot count within the 4–6 range.
swipe_cta: Add a small swipe CTA as a native iOS UI element (subtle arrow indicator, send-button hint, or small pill label — e.g. 'Swipe →' or 'See more'). Color it in the complementary/contrasting palette relative to the outfit — not the outfit's own hue. Position near the bottom input bar area so it reads as part of the phone screen UI. Keep wording minimal (2–4 words).
